slides.title: Capture by Value vs Reference
slides.prompt: What is the difference between capture '[=]' and '[&]' in a lambda?
options: '[=]' captures all local variables by value (read-only copy); '[&]' captures by reference
'[=]' captures by reference; '[&]' captures by value
'[=]' allocates on heap; '[&]' allocates on stack
slides.correctAnswer: '[=]' captures all local variables by value (read-only copy); '[&]' captures by reference
